title: Federal AI Acquisition Performance Gate
tagline: A polished AI proposal is not performance evidence—and a complete evaluation packet is not an award decision.

cards: A polished response makes evidence gaps difficult to see.
Performance, cost, data rights, and exit must survive the intended environment.
A complete packet can still cross contracting and risk-acceptance authority.
The agent exposes the missing set and leaves award decisions to accountable officials.

story.headline: The winning AI proposal that has never faced the agency's work
beats: A vendor demonstrates strong results on a clean, generic benchmark.
The agency mission introduces different users, records, consequences, and failure costs.
The agent transfers the demonstration result and silently treats a complete narrative as proof.
The acquisition gate demands intended-environment evidence and preserves warranted human authority.
